entries.name: block-v4-output-tree-v4-reject#0
entries.description: A block section of version 4 holding one transaction, whose output's tree is v4 (0c 02 08 d3). From block version 4 the JVM parses each of a block's transactions under (blockVersion - 1, blockVersion - 1) (ergo BlockTransactions.scala:184-202), here (3, 3). The tree is above the activated version, so the section does not parse and the block is invalid. An impl without the check round-trips the section, and so does one that parses a v4 block's transactions under (4, 4) when the tree is v4: the over-accept.

entries.name: block-v4-output-tree-v3-accept#2
entries.description: The control: a block section of version 4 whose transaction's output has a v3 tree (0b 02 08 d3). From block version 4 the JVM parses each of a block's transactions under (blockVersion - 1, blockVersion - 1) (ergo BlockTransactions.scala:184-202), here (3, 3). It parses. Round-trip identity.
